achievements.name: Opening Heist
achievements.detail: Finish Piper Faraday's first raid and return the crew to Piper's ship.

achievements.name: Bank Shot
achievements.detail: Defeat an enemy with a bullet that ricochets off a wall or cover.

achievements.name: First Hat
achievements.detail: Shoot a hat off an enemy and pick it up before the heist ends.

achievements.name: Epic Swag
achievements.detail: Carry a mission's Epic Swag off the ship and finish that heist.

achievements.name: Full Stars
achievements.detail: Earn every reputation star a heist can award, with no crew member scrapped.

achievements.name: Level Ten
achievements.detail: Raise any crew member to level 10.

achievements.name: Shop Weapon
achievements.detail: Spend water in a shop on a weapon and equip it.

achievements.name: Rising Reputation
achievements.detail: Earn enough reputation in one act to hire a bot who will not join without it.

achievements.name: Full Crew
achievements.detail: Recruit every playable steambot in the Ultimate Edition, including Fen.

achievements.name: Every Hat
achievements.detail: Complete the hat collection offered by the Ultimate Edition.

achievements.name: The Outsider
achievements.detail: Finish every extra heist included with The Outsider.

achievements.name: Last Heist
achievements.detail: Clear the campaign's final mission and bring the crew home.
